description: Average aCL IgG and ANA over all matched examination records within each sex. Each examination counts once.

a.request: For each patient sex (`Patient.SEX`), use every examination record that matches a patient (drop examinations with no matching patient), with each examination counting once even when a patient has several. Give the sex, the average `aCL IgG`, the average `ANA`, and that sex's average ANA divided by the mean of the per-sex average ANA values. Ignore missing values in all averages and don't round.
a.sql: WITH sex_stats AS (SELECT p.SEX AS sex, AVG(e.`aCL IgG`) AS avg_acl_igg, AVG(e.ANA) AS avg_ana FROM Examination e INNER JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID GROUP BY p.SEX) SELECT sex, avg_acl_igg, avg_ana, avg_ana / (SELECT AVG(avg_ana) FROM sex_stats) AS ana_ratio FROM sex_stats;

c.request: By patient sex, what are the average aCL IgG and ANA values in the examination data (only examinations linked to a patient, missing values ignored)? Also give each sex's average ANA as a ratio of the mean of the per-sex ANA averages, unrounded. Average aCL IgG and ANA over all matched examination records within each sex. Each examination counts once.
c.sql: WITH sex_avg AS (SELECT p.SEX AS sex, AVG(e.`aCL IgG`) AS avg_acl_igg, AVG(e.ANA) AS avg_ana FROM Examination e INNER JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = e.ID WHERE p.SEX IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.SEX) SELECT sex, avg_acl_igg, avg_ana, avg_ana / (SELECT AVG(avg_ana) FROM sex_avg) AS ana_ratio FROM sex_avg;

b.request: For each SEX in Patient, compute the average aCL IgG and average ANA over Examination rows inner-joined to Patient on ID (one row per examination, NULLs ignored), and report each sex's average ANA divided by the unrounded mean of the two per-sex average ANA values
b.sql: WITH sex_avg AS (SELECT p.SEX AS sex, AVG(e.`aCL IgG`) AS avg_acl_igg, AVG(e.ANA) AS avg_ana FROM Examination e INNER JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID WHERE p.SEX IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.SEX) SELECT sex, avg_acl_igg, avg_ana, avg_ana / (SELECT AVG(avg_ana) FROM sex_avg) AS ana_ratio FROM sex_avg

d.request: Across all matched examination records, what are the average aCL IgG and average ANA for each patient sex (each examination counted once, missing values ignored)? Also, what is each sex's average ANA as a ratio of the mean of the per-sex ANA averages, unrounded?
d.sql: WITH per_sex AS (SELECT p.SEX AS sex, AVG(e.`aCL IgG`) AS avg_acl_igg, AVG(e.ANA) AS avg_ana FROM Examination e JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID WHERE p.SEX IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.SEX), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ana) AS mean_ana FROM per_sex) SELECT per_sex.sex, per_sex.avg_acl_igg, per_sex.avg_ana, per_sex.avg_ana / overall.mean_ana AS ana_ratio FROM per_sex, overall;
